title: GabrielPlan
body:
Gabriel: Just us now. Here's the map, I'll draw the guards' attention.
Hana: Ok... Keep yourself safe out there. I can't do this alone.
Gabriel: And I can't fail.
<<distraction>>
Gabriel sprints and plants the charges. The officers rush towards the explosion.

title: EnterAlone
body: Gabriel: Now. I'll meet you outside. Hana has a clear path inside. She enters Alpha alone.

title: NoAnswer
body:
Hana: Gabriel!!!! Where are you? 
[Gabriel doesnt answer]
<<remote_signal>>
Gabriel[fuzzy]: All Clear. Detonate now. Don't wait up for me. Meet at Omega.

title: AlphaFalls
body:
Alpha tears apart.
Hana: What??? Did I just see our...? 
Hana: Just nerves...
<<officers_out>>
Health Officers stumble out of the entrance.

title: HanaFires
body: Hana turns toward them and fires twice.

title: OfficersFall
body: The officers fall. Hana lowers her weapon.

title: OmegaNext
body: Omega is next. Walk right to leave.
